title: Service settings
description: How one service of the example runs: where it listens, how much it logs and what it depends on.

name.description: The service's name, as the other services address it.

port.description: The TCP port the service listens on.

logLevel.description: How much the service writes to its log.

secure.description: Whether the service accepts only TLS connections.

verbose.description: Replaced by logLevel; still read for older settings.

dependsOn.description: The services this one needs before it starts.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long a request may take before it is cancelled.
